abilities.effect: Cost: 1 Conviction or ten minutes of uninterrupted work. Record two statements, logs, memories, or traces that cannot all be true. Gain two dice when testing the contradiction, and the Game Moderator identifies the missing assumption that could reconcile them. Failure: the contradiction is real, but you misidentify the altered source.

Cost: 1 Conviction and one preserved piece of evidence. Test: Resolve + Investigation opposed by Guile + Noospherics or equivalent. Establish that a person, copy, institution, process, or legal identity remains responsible despite transfer, editing, subcontracting, or ownership change. Failure: your evidence chain becomes vulnerable to counterattack.

Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. Name the operation's central unanswered question and summarize the evidence earned. The Game Moderator reveals a concrete, reachable route by which the truth can be proven. The route is not safe and may expose a campaign-changing fact.

Cost: 1 Conviction. Reaction when an ally would be incapacitated, separated, vented, captured, or removed from the local noosphere. Move toward them, stabilize them, or preserve a tether, signal, or identity lock long enough for another action. Failure: you share one level of their damage, Exposure, or Pressure.

Cost: 1 Conviction. Test: Guile + Security or Negotiation. Present as a plausible inspector, contractor, responder, inherited process, or provisional identity long enough to obtain one limited privilege. Failure: access is granted but flagged for review.

Cost: 2 Conviction and 1 Strain. After studying a power, institution, machine, organism, or security system, declare the condition under which it can be interrupted, bypassed, overloaded, embarrassed, or forced between incompatible priorities. The Game Moderator defines setup and consequence.
Cost: 1 Conviction and three willing participants. Assign practical responsibilities and a communication procedure. Members may lend one Skill die to another once per round without acting themselves.
Cost: 1 Conviction and a genuine favor. Formalize a reciprocal commitment without compulsion. Each side gains two dice when honoring it and suffers appropriate Pressure when knowingly betraying it.

Cost: 1 Vitae and one uninterrupted minute. Convert one Trauma into Impact or remove two Impact. Fire, radiation, and sunlight wounds require two Vitae. Failure: the injury closes but retains contamination or another Complication.

Cost: 2 Vitae. Reaction after catastrophic injury. Remain recoverable rather than destroyed and preserve continuity through dismemberment or equivalent harm. Full restoration requires time and suitable material or assistance.
Cost: none. By sampling blood, vital medium, psychic residue, or another approved source, learn whether it can restore Vitae, quiet Hunger, carry contamination, or provoke a Complication.

Cost: 1 Vitae. Drain one narrow capability from a willing, restrained, or defeated target: heat, regeneration, sensory acuity, stored charge, or processing priority. Gain a related temporary benefit while the target suffers a matching penalty.

Cost: 2 Vitae and 1 Hunger. During direct contact with a powerful being or continuity engine, feed on the principle sustaining its active identity. Restore Vitae to maximum and borrow one defining resistance or sense for a scene.
Cost: 1 Vitae from each participant. Share a controlled memory, emotion, or learned rhythm with another compatible participant. Failure: one unrelated memory crosses with it.

Cost: 2 Fury. Configure against one obstacle class: sealed doors, powered armor, swarms, heavy recoil, radiation, or crushing pressure. Gain an appropriate defense or attack for one scene, sacrificing another capability such as speed, speech, or fine manipulation.

Cost: 2 Fury and 1 Instinct. Assume a unique apex form built around one environment and predatory purpose. Gain Armor equal to half Archetype Rating, one extraordinary movement mode, and one severe weapon or control adaptation.
Cost: 1 Fury. Up to Archetype Rating packmates may use your Initiative or add one die to an action supporting another member. Failure: all briefly share the highest current Pressure.

Cost: 1 Fury or several minutes outside danger. Gain one limited adaptation for a scene: climbing, filtering, sealing, vibration sense, gripping, tool use, or similar function. Failure: the adaptation remains conspicuous until rest.

Cost: 2 Fury and 1 Instinct. Design a new stable form with a defined role, movement method, sensory emphasis, and one extraordinary adaptation. It cannot combine every advantage and may develop distinct instincts.
Cost: 1 Fury and an offering, service, or constraint. Form a temporary pact with a local presence and gain one narrow favor consistent with its nature.
Cost: 1 Pact. Gain one temporary sense able to perceive heat, resonance, dimensional stress, memory residue, noospheric attention, active lies, or another approved hidden quality for a scene.
Cost: 1 Pact; add 1 Intrusion if maintained beyond one scene. Gain Armor equal to half Archetype Rating and one thematic resistance. The manifestation visibly marks the pact.

Cost: 2 Pact and 1 Intrusion. Enter a controlled hybrid state granting two borrowed manifestations, one extraordinary sense, and one major resistance for a scene. The presence may speak but cannot act independently unless a negotiated boundary is violated.
Cost: none. Before accepting a bargain, ask what the other party gains, what remains owed, and what unstated resource is risked. The Game Moderator answers broadly but truthfully.
Cost: 2 Pact. Reopen one term because circumstances, identity, universe, or capability materially changed. Exchange one obligation, prohibition, or reward for comparable weight.
Cost: 1 Pact. Treat one nearby surface, opening, or reflection as adjacent to another point within several meters for sight, hearing, or touch.
Cost: 1 Pact. Step around a threshold and emerge at another visible point in the same room or connected corridor. Failure: leave a persistent echo.
Cost: 1 Resonance per scene. Link willing allies for silent communication, distress sensing, and one-die assistance to Medicine, Athletics, or Composure involving another linked member.
Cost: 1 Resonance. Reaction when a structure, vehicle, shield, or cover would fail. Move stress into another connected section and delay collapse for Archetype Rating rounds.
Cost: 1 Resonance. Test: Presence + Performance opposed by the highest Composure. Shift emotional intensity one step toward caution, urgency, grief, solidarity, suspicion, or another broad state.
Cost: 1 Bandwidth and available hardware or software. Assemble or awaken a small assistant performing one narrow recurring task with 4 dice.
Cost: 1 Bandwidth and a valid sample or consent. Assume one narrow privilege, account relationship, or legal role without copying the entire person.
